title: Prometheus: The God Who Stole Fire
opening_hook: What if one act of defiance gave humanity the power to survive?
series: Living Tapestries — The World’s Great Stories

source_integrity.primary_source_or_tradition: Hesiod, Theogony and Works and Days; Aeschylean dramatic tradition
source_integrity.narration_style: Clearly distinguish myth/legend from established history; do not present illustrative details as verified facts
source_integrity.translation_policy: New original paraphrase only; do not quote protected translations
